basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Manchester, UK, currently diving into the world of virtual reality with my new PS5. By day, I work as a marketing coordinator at a local tech startup and spend my evenings exploring new gadgets and gaming. I'm married with a baby on the way, which has recently piqued my interest in parenting communities. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, especially after dinner when I have some free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, and I've been passionate about technology since my teenage years. Most of my knowledge comes from personal exploration and keeping up with the latest tech trends. I've recently started learning more about VR through online forums and communities.
